lookup.description: Retrieve a single operator's basic information when the user supplies the operator's name. Use search to discover a name first when it is unknown.

name.description: The complete in-game operator name, such as 阿米娅. Supply a name obtained from search when the user's spelling is uncertain.

search.description: Search one category of game records for the user's query. Return matching names and identifiers so that a subsequent lookup can request one specific record.

query.description: The user's search term, preserving the original language and spelling.

scope.description: The category to search: operators or items. Select the category that matches the user's request.
